_doc: Conversation trees for staff NPCs (keyed by the staff 'dialogue' id in routines.json) plus greeting lines for students. A node: { text: [lines…] (one picked), options: [{ label, goto: node | do: action handler, args, when: condition(s), cons: consequence block, text: reply line }] }. A '🚶 Walk away' option is always added, and missions add their own options automatically.

text: Matron Grace look you over her glasses: "Yes? Wetin dey do you?"
Matron: "Another one. Sit down. Talk."
"Use the bed by the window. If I catch you pretending ehn…"
"Panadol for wetin? Headache? Malaria? Heartbreak?"

args.text: Matron give you one tablet: "Drink plenty water." 💊

options.label: 💔 "Heartbreak"
options.text: Matron laugh: "Ehn ehn. Go and read your book, that one go heal am." 😂

text: Mama Tuck-shop: "My customer! Wetin you wan buy?"
Mama Tuck-shop dey count money: "Talk quick, queue dey."
Mama look left, look right: "Who send you? …₦1,500. If dem catch you, you no know me."
Mr. Okon (whispering): "This is a QUIET zone. What do you want?"
"Read at the desks. Library reading sticks better than anywhere else in this school." (+40% study here)
"Past questions? Check the bottom shelf by the window… if they're still there." 👀
Mama Iyabo wipe sweat with her wrapper: "Ehen? Food never ready o."

options.label: 🧅 "Make I help you for kitchen" (30 min)
🍛 "I hear say jollof dey back door…"

text: Mama Iyabo laugh: "Who tell you that one? …Come back at night. ₦300." 🤫
Dr. Bamidele adjust his tie: "Young one. Speak."
The Principal: "Shouldn't you be somewhere?"

options.label: 🙇 Greet properly
options.text: "Good. Manners maketh man. Off you go."

options.label: 📝 Ask for exeat (go home for weekend)

text: "Exeat? With which reason? Go and read your book." 😑
Baba Musa: "Ina zuwa? Where you dey go?"
The House Master: "What is it? Make it quick."
"If this is about your Milo, I don't want to hear it."
"Then go to the sick bay! Am I a doctor?"
Rev. Ekanem smiles: "My child. Peace be with you."

options.text: He lay hand for your head. You feel lighter. 🙏

options.text: "God forgives. The house master… maybe not." 😅

text: Imam Abdullahi: "Assalamu alaikum. How is your heart?"

options.text: He make dua for you. Sabr. Patience. 🤲
